units.text: It reads MSG files from streams using mapi_message::from_stream and writes them back using mapi_message::save. It creates new messages with mapi_message::create, sets sender information with set_sender_name and set_sender_email_address, adds recipients with add_recipient, and attaches binary content with add_attachment. It writes EML files to streams using mapi_message::save_to_eml.

Create, edit, save, and reload Outlook-style messages through mapi_message, setting the subject, plain-text and HTML bodies, and sender identity, or reaching arbitrary MAPI properties via set_property/get_property_value with common_message_property_id and property_type_code.
Read, build, and write generic Compound File Binary containers directly through cfb_reader, cfb_storage/cfb_stream, and cfb_writer, working with file paths, in-memory streams, or raw byte buffers.
Save an in-memory mapi_message to .eml and load .eml back into a mapi_message, both through the library's own MIME engine, with no external MIME dependency.

Add To/Cc/Bcc recipients with add_recipient(), attach regular files from byte buffers or streams with add_attachment(), and nest a full mapi_message as an embedded-message attachment with add_embedded_message_attachment().
Read a subject from an MSG file opened as a binary stream using Aspose.Email FOSS for Cpp.
Create a message with sender, recipient, and attachment, then save it as both MSG and EML using Aspose.Email FOSS for Cpp.

Aspose.Email FOSS for Cpp provides the mapi_message class as the primary high-level entry point for creating, editing, and reloading messages, while lower-level classes such as msg_reader, msg_document, msg_writer, cfb_reader, cfb_document, and cfb_writer expose the underlying MSG and CFB container structure directly for callers that need it.

The aspose.email.foss namespace exposes the Aspose.Email FOSS for Cpp library version 0.1.0, requires C++17 and CMake 3.26 or later, and provides high-level message handling via mapi_message alongside low-level access to MSG and CFB structures through dedicated reader, document, and writer classes.

Aspose.Email FOSS for Cpp reads and writes MSG, CFB, and EML containers and messages stored on disk, in memory, or in a stream; it supports MSG-format messages and generic CFB containers, and provides a curated subset of MAPI property accessors on mapi_message.
It does not support SMTP, IMAP, POP3, or other network mail-protocol operations, nor does it function as a mail client or transport library.
It does not support PST (Outlook Personal Folders) archive files, only single MSG-format messages and generic CFB containers.

Only a curated subset of MAPI properties has a dedicated named accessor on mapi_message; every other property must be read and written through the generic get_property_value() and set_property() pair with common_message_property_id and property_type_code.

The cfb_document class represents a Compound File Binary document and provides methods to load it from various sources and access its root storage, version information, and transaction signature number.
The cfb_exception class represents an exception thrown during Compound File Binary processing.

The cfb_node class represents a node in a Compound File Binary structure, providing access to its name, class identifier, creation and modification times, state bits, and whether it is a storage or stream.
The cfb_reader class reads a Compound File Binary document and provides access to its header, directory entries, FAT, mini FAT, DIFAT, and stream data.
The cfb_storage class represents a storage node in a Compound File Binary document and allows adding child storages and streams.
The cfb_stream class represents a stream node in a Compound File Binary document and provides access to its data.
The cfb_writer class writes a Compound File Binary document to a file or stream.
The directory_color_flag enumeration indicates the color of a directory entry in a Compound File Binary document.

The directory_entry class represents an entry in the directory of a Compound File Binary document and provides access to its name, class identifier, creation and modification times, color flag, and size.
The directory_object_type enumeration indicates the type of a directory entry in a Compound File Binary document.
The header class represents the header of a Compound File Binary document.
The sector_marker enumeration indicates the type of a sector in a Compound File Binary document.
The common_message_property_id enumeration defines standard property identifiers for MAPI messages.
The mapi_attachment class represents an attachment in a MAPI message.
The mapi_message class represents a MAPI message and provides methods to set properties, add recipients and attachments, and save the message.
The mapi_property class represents a property of a MAPI message.
The mapi_property_collection class represents a collection of MAPI properties.
The mapi_recipient class represents a recipient in a MAPI message.
The msg_document class represents a MSG document and provides access to its structure and content.
The msg_exception class represents an exception thrown during MSG processing.
The msg_reader class reads a MSG document and provides access to its Compound File Binary structure.
The msg_storage class represents a storage in a MSG document.
The msg_storage_role enumeration indicates the role of a storage in a MSG document.
The msg_stream class represents a stream in a MSG document.
The msg_writer class writes a MSG document to a file or stream.
The property_type_code enumeration defines type codes for MAPI properties.
